newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Parliament's two chambers opened sessions to elect their leading boards, but majority centrists and opposition leftists have so far failed to agree on a carve-up.
* Adrian Nastase, executive president of the Party of Social Democracy, said his main opposition party should get more than the position of vice-president of the Chamber of Deputies.

* Tuesday's appointment of Democratic Party (PD) leader Petre Roman as Senate speaker and of National Peasant Party leader Ion Diaconescu as lower house speaker shows that the ruling coalition works, PD vice president Victor Babiuc told a news conference.
* Babiuc said the cabinet list was nearly ready and that a short-term government programme for the next four months would be completed on Saturday. A long-term programme was also being drafted.
* Babiuc said Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea could be officially appointed next Wednesday, when he would announce the his ministers.
* Babiuc said the Hungarian Democratic Union's (UDMR) participation in the government is no threat to Romania as long as the UDMR respects the constitution.

* The National Liberal Party (PNL) will hold six portfolios in the new government -- communications, industry, media, trade, youth and relations with parliament -- PNL vice president Viorel Catarama said.
* Catarama said he was not unhappy with what his party had obtained during talks for the new cabinet.

* Chief prosecutor Nicolae Cochinescu appealed to courts to rule on corruption cases. He said he ordered nationwide investigations in connection with international adoptions. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
